_about: Photo library, all 1080x1920 graded JPGs. 'points' are pixel coordinates for label leaders. 'used_in' lists episodes; prefer photos used least recently. Add every new photo here.

hero.desc: Aerial drone shot, white ~60ft motor yacht cruising fast over turquoise Red Sea reef water, white wake

shaft.desc: Underwater view of yacht stern: twin inclined propeller shafts, bronze props, two rudders, trim tabs, sandy seabed

ips.desc: Underwater view of yacht stern with two Volvo IPS pod drives, forward-facing twin props, deep blue water, reef

marina.desc: Top-down aerial of white motor yacht entering a tight berth between yachts in a marina, turquoise water, white pontoons

engine.desc: Bright yacht engine room, marine engineer in navy uniform and black gloves servicing a white diesel engine, stainless exhaust pipes

ep002-cutaway.desc: Illustrated stern cut-away: engine room window, seacock under hull, strainer, raw-water pump, heat exchanger, wet exhaust spraying from transom, sea below

ep002-freshloop.desc: Blueprint schematic: engine block with closed coolant loop (hot red out, cooled gold back) to a heat exchanger; seawater tubes in/out on the right

ep002-impeller.desc: Blueprint close-up of a raw-water pump: housing with bolts, cam, black rubber impeller with 12 flexible blades, brass shaft

ep002-impeller-worn.desc: Same pump with a damaged impeller: 3 broken blade stubs circled in coral, cracks, loose blade fragments

ep002-cta.desc: Faint worn-impeller on blueprint grid - calm background for text-heavy scenes

ep003-roll.desc: Illustrated bow-on (front view) white motor yacht heeled ~13 deg on a swell, faint ghost rolled the other way, gold double-headed roll arc above, turquoise sea

ep003-gyro.desc: Blueprint bow-on hull cross-section with a gyro stabilizer: sealed sphere, gold flywheel with spin arrow, cradle; coral roll arrow vs turquoise counter-push arrow above

ep003-gyro-close.desc: Same gyro blueprint cross-section without the roll arrows (good for close zooms)

ep003-anchor.desc: Illustrated side-profile yacht at anchor on calm water, glowing gyro inside the hull, anchor chain to sandy seabed, clean hull bottom

ep003-fins.desc: Underwater bow-on view of a yacht hull with two fin stabilizers, left fin lifting (turquoise arrow up), right fin pushing down (coral arrow)

ep003-speed.desc: Illustrated side-profile yacht at speed, fin stabilizer visible under the hull, wake and speed lines astern

ep003-cta.desc: Faint rolling-yacht illustration on blueprint grid - calm background for text-heavy scenes

ep004-tank.desc: Warm amber 'heat' background, sun right; cut-away steel fuel tank: amber diesel, black slime mat at fuel/water interface, blue water layer at bottom

ep004-condense.desc: Day/night split sky (sun left, moon right); half-empty cut-away tank with condensation drops on upper walls, drops falling through diesel, water layer; caption text 'HOT DAY + COOL NIGHT = DROPS' at y1370

ep004-microbes.desc: Microscope circle view of the fuel/water interface: amber diesel above, blue water below, green rod bacteria, purple yeast blobs, fungal threads on a black mat

ep004-filter.desc: Fuel filter / water separator: red head with amber in/out pipes, red element can, clear bowl with diesel, black sludge and water at bottom, drain valve

ep004-polish.desc: Teal grid; fuel polishing loop: dirty tank left, pump (coral), filter + water separator column right, clean amber fuel returning to tank

ep004-cta.desc: Faint fuel filter bowl on dark warm gradient - calm background for text-heavy CTA

ep005-hook.desc: Dusk side view at the waterline: trawler-style displacement yacht (left, sitting deep) vs sport cruiser planing with bow up and spray (right), sunset glitter, cut-away sea

ep005-displace.desc: Dusk side view: big trawler-style displacement yacht sitting deep, red bottom + full keel under water, gold arrows showing water pushed aside

ep005-hullspeed.desc: Trawler sitting in the trough between its own bow wave and stern wave at hull speed; gold bracket 'WAVE LENGTH = BOAT LENGTH' at y~1262-1306

ep005-planing.desc: Dusk side view: white/navy sport cruiser planing, bow up ~4 deg, foam wake, gold lift arrows under the hull

ep005-vee.desc: Blueprint bow-on cross-sections at a waterline: faint round displacement bottom (left) vs bright V-shaped planing bottom with chines and strakes (right)

ep005-chop.desc: Dusk choppy sea: sport cruiser launching off a wave, bow high, spray bursts - slamming / cost of speed

ep005-cta.desc: Blurred, darkened ep005 hook (two boats at sunset) - calm background for text-heavy CTA

ep006-hook.desc: Underwater side view of a yacht stern: red antifouled hull, shaft with a pitted half-eaten zinc collar, bronze prop, rudder, turquoise current sparks

ep006-guard.desc: Same stern with brand-new silver shaft, hull and trim-tab anodes, gold current lines, turquoise shield ring around the propeller

ep006-leak.desc: Same stern, darker reddish water, badly eaten shaft anode with coral current sparks (stray current / electrical leak)

ep006-battery.desc: Blueprint grid: seawater tank with bronze plate (left) and pitted dissolving zinc plate (right) joined by glowing wire with lightning icon; galvanic cell

ep006-wear.desc: Deep-teal panel with three shaft anode collars: new (tick), half gone (gold circle), painted navy (coral X)

ep006-cta.desc: Blurred, darkened ep006 hook stern - calm background for CTA

ep007-hook.desc: Night at anchor: indigo starry sky, crescent moon, yacht with warm cabin lights, glowing cut-away compartment with a black AGM and a white LFP battery, light reflections on water

ep007-agm.desc: Violet studio: big cut-away black AGM battery, grey lead plates alternating with white glass mats, gold glow, +/- terminals

ep007-agm-level.desc: Violet studio: AGM battery gauge, top half gold (usable), bottom half hatched coral (keep in reserve), white line at 50%

ep007-lfp.desc: Violet studio: cut-away white lithium (LiFePO4) battery, green BMS board on top, four blue 3.2V prismatic cells, turquoise glow

ep007-lfp-level.desc: Violet studio: lithium battery gauge ~92% turquoise usable, thin reserve band at bottom

ep007-scale.desc: Violet studio: gold balance scale, heavy AGM pan down (coral arrow) vs light LFP pan up (turquoise arrow)

ep007-charge.desc: Violet studio wiring diagram: ALTERNATOR -> PROTECTION -> LFP battery with BMS, LITHIUM CHARGER feeding battery, glowing wires

ep007-cta.desc: Blurred, darkened ep007 night-anchor hook - calm background for CTA

ep008-hook.desc: Thermal-camera (iron palette) view of a motor yacht at anchor: hot sun and hot sea glow orange/yellow, air-conditioned cabin windows glow cool purple, HUD crosshairs 'SEA 31°C' and 'CABIN 22°C'

ep008-loop.desc: Noon daylight yacht with white cut-away showing marine AC seawater loop: thru-hull intake, strainer, pump, AC unit with cold air rising, red warm discharge out of the topsides into the sea

ep008-coil.desc: Close-up of an AC condenser: copper refrigerant coil inside a turquoise seawater jacket, orange heat squiggles, water in (turq arrow left) / out (coral arrow right), light background

ep008-seas.desc: Thermal split screen: left cool purple sea 22°C with long heat arrows leaving the coil, right hot orange sea 31°C with short arrows

ep008-strainer.desc: Top view of a sea strainer basket clogged with green weed and shells, on a light background

ep008-help.desc: Noon daylight yacht with cream blinds closed over the saloon windows and a strong AC discharge stream from the topsides

ep008-cta.desc: Blurred, darkened ep008-hook thermal yacht (CTA background)

ep009-hook.desc: Paper-cut craft style: centre-console boat with outboard on the transom (top) above a cruiser with cut-away showing inboard engine, shaft, prop and rudder (bottom); peach paper sky, layered turquoise paper sea

ep009-outboard.desc: Paper-cut style close side view of centre-console boat stern with outboard motor: cowling, drive leg, propeller underwater

ep009-tilt.desc: Paper-cut style: centre-console boat in a shallow sandy bay with its outboard tilted up out of the water

ep009-inboard.desc: Paper-cut style motor cruiser with cut-away panel: inboard engine low and central, shaft, strut, bronze prop, rudder, teak swim platform

ep009-platform.desc: Paper-cut style close-up of motor cruiser stern with clean teak swim platform and ladder at right edge

ep009-engineroom.desc: Paper-cut cross-section of a hull looking forward: big orange inboard engine filling the bilge, pumps/filters squeezed at sides, person reaching in through deck hatch

ep009-cta.desc: Blurred, darkened ep009-hook for CTA background
